how.host: played by a script on the deployed host, on every release
how.local: played by a script in real Chrome on the build of the same commit, not on the host
how.rules: held by a test of the rules, run on every change
how.hand: needs a person, or a browser driven by one

onEveryRelease: npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.json tools/uat-check.ts <host> ar <out dir>
npm test (the rules tests ran in the build that made the release)

scenarios.asks: Read the release pointer at the start and at the end
scenarios.by: release-regression.ts

scenarios.asks: Load the five English addresses in desktop Chrome
scenarios.by: release-regression.ts; uat-check.ts does the same in a second language with the music

scenarios.asks: Verify the 3D renderer, then the fallback on purpose
scenarios.by: release-regression.ts opens each address in 3D and again with no3d=1

scenarios.asks: Onboarding, starting resources and objective
scenarios.by: granada-play.ts starts through the brief; village.gtest.ts holds the starting figures
scenarios.missing: Nothing reads the starting figures off the page on the host

scenarios.asks: Harvest a ripe field, sell, feedback
scenarios.by: granada-play.ts harvests through the page; village.gtest.ts and economy.gtest.ts hold the store, the overflow and the sale
scenarios.missing: Whether the feedback is clear is a person's judgement

scenarios.asks: Inspect and repair the broken channel; water after; the mill wheel follows the water
scenarios.by: granada-play.ts orders the repair; village.gtest.ts holds half flow before and full flow after
scenarios.missing: The wheel standing still without water and turning with it is not checked by any script

scenarios.asks: Every tab; an immediate buy and sell
scenarios.by: economy.gtest.ts: a round trip loses money and none can be made by carrying goods; granada-play.ts opens the market
scenarios.missing: Not every tab is opened by the script

scenarios.asks: Normal, fast, pause and the keys 1 to 5, P, N, H, O, Home
scenarios.by: granada-play.ts passes and stops the days and steers by keys
scenarios.missing: Not every key in the list is pressed

scenarios.asks: Drag, turn, zoom, pick a field, see it selected
scenarios.by: granada-play.ts opens a field by clicking it in 3D and steers by keys
scenarios.missing: Dragging and zooming by pointer are not scripted

scenarios.asks: Build valid and invalid; placement and collision; nothing lost on refusal
scenarios.by: village.gtest.ts and economy.gtest.ts: a refused order returns the very same state
scenarios.missing: Buildings stand on fixed lots: the game has no free placement, so no collision exists to test

scenarios.asks: Save, reload without fresh=1, compare the whole state
scenarios.by: screen.gtest.ts: a save comes back exactly and plays on to the same end; granada-play.ts reloads and resumes the same day

scenarios.asks: A winning year and a year lost by neglect
scenarios.by: village.gtest.ts holds both; granada-play.ts carries a whole campaign to its end through the page
scenarios.missing: The neglect year is played in the rules, not through the page

scenarios.asks: Look at the houses, mosque, mill, bridge, walkers and both cart routes
scenarios.by: valley.gtest.ts holds that each is built soundly; nothing checks that it can be seen
scenarios.missing: The reviewer could not make out the carts on two roads or the walkers' lean

scenarios.asks: Four seasons, day and night, weather, water, sound
scenarios.by: granada-shot.ts captures the four seasons for a person to look at
scenarios.missing: There is no day and night and no sound but the music

scenarios.asks: A 60-minute soak and repeated restarts, watching for leaks
scenarios.missing: Never run

scenarios.asks: All three scenarios from the brief to a win or a loss
scenarios.by: golden-age-play.ts drives a whole campaign through the screen; golden-age.gtest.ts and screen.gtest.ts play every scenario to an end in the rules
scenarios.missing: The script's whole campaign through the screen is one scenario at a time, when asked

scenarios.asks: Valid and invalid canal and building, why a control is disabled, undo, resources intact
scenarios.by: golden-age-play.ts: a refused action changes nothing, undo works; golden-age.gtest.ts: step refuses whatever preview refuses

scenarios.asks: The forecast against what the season then does
scenarios.by: screen.gtest.ts: previews the season exactly, without playing it
scenarios.missing: Held in the rules, not read off the page

scenarios.asks: A building that is not working says why, and works again once supplied
scenarios.by: screen.gtest.ts: marks the plots where something is not doing its job
scenarios.missing: The restoration is not played through the page

scenarios.asks: Research chosen, finished, unlocking; library, school, hospital effects
scenarios.by: golden-age.gtest.ts: research in order, nothing lost on a change; golden-age-play.ts picks research
scenarios.missing: The hospital's effect is not checked by a script

scenarios.asks: Chapter 3: what an endowment costs and saves; the four-endowment win
scenarios.by: screen.gtest.ts: endowed once, for five years of upkeep; no win without four; golden-age-play.ts endows through the page

scenarios.asks: Chapter 3: a trading run that wins and a trade-heavy run that fails
scenarios.by: handoff.gtest.ts: one workshop, one market and the heavy tax alone ends rich and unwon on 200 seeds; the trading city that also builds wins
scenarios.missing: Held in the rules, not played through the page on the host

scenarios.asks: Save and reload the right scenario; scenarios kept apart
scenarios.by: golden-age-play.ts reloads; screen.gtest.ts: a save comes back as it was
scenarios.missing: That one scenario's save cannot be taken for another's is not asserted through the page

scenarios.asks: A museum link's label and where it leads
scenarios.by: screen.gtest.ts: links by record id with a label in every language; golden-age-play.ts reads the addresses
scenarios.missing: The museum page at the other end is not opened by a script

scenarios.asks: Keyboard, camera, the plan view; a 1280 by 800 window
scenarios.by: golden-age-play.ts plays by keyboard alone and from the plan
scenarios.missing: No run at 1280 by 800

scenarios.asks: Building animation, people, boats, carts, weather, day and night, sound
scenarios.missing: Most of it does not exist in the game

scenarios.asks: Repeated changes of scenario and language; a four-hour soak
scenarios.missing: Never run

scenarios.asks: All five daily rounds
scenarios.by: release-regression.ts

scenarios.asks: Pins by mouse, by keyboard and Enter, by typed coordinates
scenarios.by: release-regression.ts

scenarios.asks: A region hint and a century estimate; their cost and the summary
scenarios.by: release-regression.ts takes both and finds them kept; atlas.gtest.ts: the hint is charged once, on that round only

scenarios.asks: Each round's distance and score, and the total
scenarios.by: release-regression.ts: the total shown equals the sum of the five rounds; atlas.gtest.ts holds the scoring

scenarios.asks: Every 'Battle of X' or 'Siege of X': the clue against the place revealed
scenarios.by: fairness.gtest.ts: no round in the whole pack is named for one place and scored at another
scenarios.missing: The whole pack is checked, not a sample on the page

scenarios.asks: Drag, rotate, zoom, pins at the edge, pin alignment, layers, overlays, timeline
scenarios.by: sphere.gtest.ts: a pin falls where the globe shows the place; atlas-play.ts turns and zooms
scenarios.missing: There are no layers, overlays or timeline in the game

scenarios.asks: Every round opens with the globe there; no reload needed
scenarios.by: release-regression.ts plays the reviewer's own game with no reload across rounds 1 to 3; fairness.gtest.ts: a new round is the whole globe

scenarios.asks: Reload in the middle and at the end; the daily game kept, practice apart
scenarios.by: release-regression.ts reloads in the middle and after the end; atlas.gtest.ts holds the save
scenarios.missing: That practice leaves the daily game alone is not checked through the page

scenarios.asks: At least 25 practice rounds across the categories
scenarios.by: atlas.gtest.ts deals practice games from a seed
scenarios.missing: No script plays practice; the game has no landmark category

scenarios.asks: 100 round changes, 100 language changes, resizes, a lost graphics context, a memory soak
scenarios.missing: Never run

scenarios.asks: English in full; Arabic and Urdu right to left; the other four spot-checked
scenarios.by: uat-check.ts opens every game in a chosen language; the play scripts take a language and check the direction
scenarios.missing: No native speaker has read any language

scenarios.asks: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape and the shortcuts; focus seen; no trap
scenarios.missing: Never run as a whole traversal

scenarios.asks: 1280 by 800 and the target size: nothing cut off, overlapping or out of reach
scenarios.missing: Never run

scenarios.asks: Mute and volume, music, ambience, effects, a tab in the background
scenarios.by: uat-check.ts: silent before a click, a track after one; music.gtest.ts holds the control
scenarios.missing: There is no ambience and there are no effects; a background tab is not tested

scenarios.asks: Old and damaged saves; static hosting; no network needed but museum links
scenarios.by: The save tests of each game; release-smoke.ts fails on any request to another origin; the offline package's own check

scenarios.asks: The game beside its target image, frame by frame, signed off
scenarios.missing: Needs the founder's eye; no frames have been set beside the targets

added.asks: While a game's history is pending review, its own page says so wherever it states or links history
added.by: release-regression.ts reads the words off Granada's brief, The Golden Age's brief and Atlas's reveal in English; review-mark.gtest.ts holds them in all seven languages
added.missing: Read on the host in English only
added.why: The founder's rule of 26 November 2026. It is the museum's own scenario, not one of the reviewer's
